messages:
deploy-bot: region-swap started: eu-west weight -> green-v2 (start=3781234567). prechecks passed, rolling to 60%

sre-anna: seeing spike in 503s from eu-west-edge around 3781234574, correlating with swap

oncall-luis: paging — impact: elevated 5xx for users routed to eu-west (chat + embed APIs). Adding ppl

eng-max: logs show edge proxy returning 503 with upstream "no healthy backends" intermittently. dumping recent route state...

infra-rob: quick check: control plane succeeded setting new weights but some edge nodes still have old upstream pin (sticky-route TTL). hypothesis: partial config + DNS TTL caused orphaned edge routing to green where backends not ready

prod-lucy: customers flagged: 3 enterprise customers reported failures hitting eu-west. CS pinged them and asked for mitigation timeline :hourglass_flowing_sand:

custsuccess-anya: collecting customer list and impact windows, will DM legal for SLO notes. Any ETA on rollback?

eng-max: recommending immediate kill-switch on the rollout flag and force-rollback to blue. command: `redwoodctl rollout cancel --region eu-west --strategy weight-restore`

deploy-bot: rollback request acknowledged. Initiating flag kill-switch (reason: partial orphaned routes). Steps: 1) set flag to OFF 2) restore previous weights 3) flush edge route cache

infra-rob: running restore weights now: `infra-cli set-weight eu-west blue 100` -> response: OK. Pushing cache flush to edge fleet (fanout)

eng-max: running quick probe against a previously failing host: ````
curl -v https://api.eu-west.redwood.ai/health
* Connected to api.eu-west.redwood.ai
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"status":"ok","version":"blue-2026-03-17"}
````

sre-anna: monitoring: 5xx rate down to baseline in last 60s, latency returning to normal. Reopening incident if flare. :white_check_mark:

prod-lucy: temporary message to affected customers sent, apologizing and noting rollback performed. CS will follow up with RCA once available.

custsuccess-anya: thanks — will log ticket numbers and affected orgs.

eng-max: postmortem notes: root cause likely combination of sticky edge route state (long TTL on a subset) + new green variant missing a health-check header that made some backends be filtered by edge health check logic. Follow-ups: add rollout gating to verify edge route convergence + add canary test for health-check header presence.

infra-rob: creating follow-up infra task: reduce sticky TTL for edge route updates and add a preflight to verify config propagated to 99% of nodes before weight change >30%

oncall-luis: incident closed for paging. Will hand off to eng for RCA and to CS for customer comms. If anyone sees regression, reopen thread.

deploy-bot: incident summary: partial regional rollout caused orphaned edge routes -> elevated 5xx -> flag kill-switch + rollback executed -> impact mitigated. Ticket: INC-2026-0478.

eng-max: assigning action owners: infra-rob (edge TTL/change preflight), eng-max (health-check header canary), prod-lucy + custsuccess-anya (customer follow-ups). ETA for fixes: 3 days for preflight automation, 1 day for canary test.

sre-anna: adding brief to postmortem doc, will include timeline and signal graphs. Closing slack thread.
